How it works

How white label senior living works.

Each partner does what it does best, so your health system gets senior living without building a new business.

01

  • Your name on the building

Boldt does not operate senior living communities. An experienced operator always runs the community.

For senior living owners

Sell the building. Keep your name on the door.

Running a senior living community takes time and money away from healthcare. Boldt can buy the real estate and bring in an experienced operator, while your name can stay on the building and residents keep their home.

Questions

What health systems ask first

Does Boldt operate the community?

No. Boldt handles the real estate and financing. An experienced senior living operator runs the community day to day.

Whose name is on the building?

Yours. That is the point of white label senior living: residents and families see your health system's name, while the operator runs the community.

How is it set up?

Two ways. In a joint venture, your health system and Boldt invest together, your name goes on the community and an experienced operator runs it behind the scenes. If you already own senior living, you can sell the real estate to Boldt and an experienced operator takes over daily operations.

How is the operator chosen?

[Describe how Boldt selects operators and your health system's role in the choice.]

We already own a community. Can this work for us?

Yes. Boldt can buy the real estate and transition daily operations to an experienced operator, while your name can stay on the building. See how a transition works.
